Ally Financial INC (ALLY) Shareholder Wedge Capital Management L LP Cut Stake by $5.10 Million as Shares Declined Posted by Pete Kolinski 15 pm
Wedge Capital Management L LP decreased its stake in Ally Financial Inc (ALLY) by 2.43% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wedge Capital Management L LP sold 196,343 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.72% with the market. The institutional investor held 7.90M shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $208.90 million, down from 8.09 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wedge Capital Management L LP who had been investing in Ally Financial Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $9.40 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.09% or $0.25 during the last trading session, reaching $22.75. About 4.39 million shares traded or 27.86% up from the average. Ally Financial Inc. (NYSE:ALLY) has declined 14.03% downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.03% the S&P500.
Wedge Capital Management L L P, which manages about $10.84 billion and $10.44 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) by 513,042 shares to 521,638 shares, valued at $59.66M in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Murphy Oil Corporation (NYSE:MUR) by 554,530 shares in the quarter, for a total of 5.31 million shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Analysts await Ally Financial Inc. (NYSE:ALLY) to report earnings on January, 29. They expect $0.81 EPS, up 15.71 % or $0.11 from last year’s $0.7 per share. ALLY’s profit will be $334.61M for 7.02 P/E if the $0.81 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.91 actual EPS reported by Ally Financial Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -10.99 % negative EPS growth.
